propositions: Outbound sync currently fails closed on any mutation targeting projects other than a single configured project due to the cross-project guard
Create mutations do not resolve per-ticket target projects but instead use a single construction-time default from the transport client
The cross-project guard must relax from equality check to set membership to permit creates/updates to any synced project in the store mapping
A ticket resolving to a project absent from the store mapping must not emit a create mutation to prevent creation against unsynced projects
The reserved key _bridge_target_project must be dropped before sending DC create fields to Jira to avoid HTTP 400 field validation errors
Both Cloud and Data Center transports must read the resolved target project from the create mutation payload to support multi-project outbound dispatch
